knowledgeArticles.title: Kubernetes Node & Kubelet Recovery SOP
knowledgeArticles.summary: Guidance for resolving Kubelet daemon failures, node NotReady states, and container runtime communication issues.
symptoms: Kubernetes worker node status transitions to 'NotReady'.
Kubelet service fails to start or reports connection refused to API server.
Container runtime endpoints timed out in logs.
knowledgeArticles.rootCause: Kubelet certificate expiration, swap space enabled blocking kubelet startup, or containerd service crash.
resolutionSteps: ssh root@192.168.100.101 "Inspect kubelet status: 'systemctl status kubelet'"
ssh root@192.168.100.101 "Check containerd state and restart if dead: 'systemctl restart containerd'"
ssh root@192.168.100.101 "Disable swap space if enabled: 'swapoff -a'"
ssh root@192.168.100.101 "View kubelet logs for exact API server handshake failures: 'journalctl -u kubelet -n 50 --no-pager'"
ssh root@192.168.100.101 "Restart kubelet daemon: 'systemctl restart kubelet' and verify node status with 'kubectl get nodes'"
